title: Score contribution and correction manifest v1
description: Claim-level explainability for a period figure. Every delta that moved a participant's period total is one entry, so a standing can be explained to the participant it describes and an appeal is about an arithmetic rather than about a feeling. docs/architecture/SERVER_API_DATA_AND_RANKING_CONTRACT.md is the normative owner. Contributions are keyed on the erasure-domain pseudonym and are retained after an erasure with the claim reference cleared.

token_burn_total.description: The sum of every non-superseded token_burn_delta below. A manifest whose entries do not sum to it is a defect in the aggregation, not a rounding difference: the whole path is integer.

claim_id.description: Absent on a consolidation contribution, which has no single originating claim, and cleared on every contribution whose claim an erasure deleted. The arithmetic stays auditable; the link to the claim does not survive.

origin.description: consolidation carries D-070 duplicate-account contributions under the surviving identity, preserving original period attribution. Stored account totals are never added together, so a consolidation is a set of claim-level deltas rather than one summed figure.

token_burn_delta.description: Signed, and the sign is fixed by the origin: `retraction` is negative and nothing else is. A signed column alone does not carry a direction — an addition of -5 and a retraction of 5 are the same row — and D-263 composes a period as the checked sum of additions minus the checked sum of retractions, which needs the two to be distinguishable. planning-schema.sql carries the same rule as a CHECK. A correction inserts an inverse delta and a forward delta rather than editing the original, which is what keeps the accepted claim immutable.
